definitions.explanation: A swimming stroke performed while floating on the back. The arms alternate in a windmill motion while the legs perform a flutter kick. The only competitive stroke started in the water rather than from a diving block.

examples.japanese: {背泳|せおよ}ぎ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦つけなくて→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧。
examples.english: With backstroke, you don't have to put your face in the water.

examples.japanese: {背泳|せおよ}ぎ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{天井|てんじょう}→天井：05008_tenjou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}ながら→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦{泳|およ}ぐ→泳ぐ：00545_oyogu⟧。
examples.english: You swim backstroke while looking at the ceiling.

examples.japanese: {背泳|せおよ}ぎ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{壁|かべ}→壁：01290_kabe⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ぶつかり→ぶつかる：02412_butsukaru⟧そう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: I almost hit the wall while swimming backstroke.

examples.japanese: {背泳|せおよ}ぎ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦まっすぐ→まっすぐ：00866_massugu⟧⟦{泳|およ}ぐ→泳ぐ：00545_oyogu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{難|むずか}しい→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧。
examples.english: It's hard to swim in a straight line doing backstroke.

examples.japanese: ⟦{水泳|すいえい}→水泳：01623_suiei⟧⟦{教室|きょうしつ}→教室：00794_kyoushitsu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{背泳|せおよ}ぎ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{習|なら}い→習う：00479_narau⟧⟦{始|はじ}めた→〜始める：18370_hajimeru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{沈|しず}んで→沈む：02061_shizumu⟧⟦しまって→しまう：03064_shimau⟧⟦なかなか→なかなか：01547_nakanaka⟧⟦{上達|じょうたつ}→上達：03346_joutatsu⟧⟦しない→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I started learning backstroke in swimming class, but my body keeps sinking and I'm not improving easily.

notes:
ALTERNATE NAMES:
・バックストローク (backstroke - from English)
・{背|せ}{浮|う}き (floating on back - basic position)

TECHNIQUE:
・バタ{足|あし} (flutter kick)
・{腕|うで}の{回転|かいてん} (arm rotation)
・{体|からだ}のローリング (body rolling)

CHARACTERISTICS:
・Face stays above water (easier breathing)
・Cannot see where you're going
・Uses flags ({背泳|せおよ}ぎフラッグ) to warn of approaching wall
・Started from in the water, not diving block

COMPETITIVE EVENTS:
・50m, 100m, 200m {背泳|せおよ}ぎ
・Swum first in {個人|こじん}メドレー (individual medley)
・First leg of メドレーリレー (medley relay)

TIPS FOR LEARNERS:
・{耳|みみ}まで{水|みず}に{浸|つ}かる (submerge ears)
・{腰|こし}を{浮|う}かせる (keep hips up)
・まっすぐ{泳|およ}ぐのが{難|むずか}しい (swimming straight is difficult)

COLLOCATIONS:
・{背泳|せおよ}ぎで{泳|およ}ぐ (to swim backstroke)
・{背泳|せおよ}ぎのターン (backstroke turn)
